name: Maulbronn Monastery Complex
description: Maulbronn Monastery, in Baden-Württemberg in southwestern Germany, is a Cistercian abbey founded in 1147 and still enclosed by its turreted walls and gate tower. Its church, cloister and other buildings, raised between the 12th and 16th centuries, make it one of Europe's best-preserved medieval monasteries. Look, too, for the network of canals and reservoirs the monks built to manage water.
